objective: Reproduce and compare exact-rational thermodynamic spectral-gap certificates, formally verified theorem statements, numerical SDP candidate bounds, and finite-size SU(2)-resolved exact-diagonalization spectra for the spherical fermionic Laughlin V1 Hamiltonian.
claim_ceiling: This is a benchmark plan and source registry. Luminous has not yet reproduced Gao's certificate, run an independent exact verifier, computed any finite-size spectra, or formalized the improved 1/5 bound in Lean.

model.name: Spherical fermionic Laughlin V1 parent Hamiltonian
model.hilbert_space: antisymmetric N-particle subspace of wedge^N U_Q
model.pair_projector: orthogonal projector onto relative angular momentum one / pair spin Q-1
conventions: Every unordered pair projector has coefficient exactly one.
Do not rescale by N, pair count, flux, sphere area, or magnetic length.
Record basis ordering, orbital phases, Clebsch-Gordan convention, and total angular momentum labels.
The Fock-space inequality H_Q^2 >= gamma*H_Q is distinct from the fixed-filling spherical gap statement.
The thermodynamic threshold in all cited spherical results is existential unless a source provides an explicit N0/Q0.

finite_size_protocol.size_sweep: Select the largest tractable N values after estimating Hilbert-space dimensions; publish the complete requested set and all failed/unconverged cases.
methods: Dense exact diagonalization for smallest N.
Sparse Lanczos / Krylov for larger sectors.
Matrix-free Hamiltonian action as an independent path.
SU(2) decomposition by total angular momentum L.
Independent pair-projector constructions from Clebsch-Gordan coefficients and annihilator/pseudopotential representation.
required_checks: Laughlin polynomial is antisymmetric and lies in the zero-energy kernel.
Pair projectors are Hermitian, idempotent and positive semidefinite.
Every allowed L sector is searched for the lowest positive eigenvalue.
Dense, sparse and matrix-free actions agree on overlapping test sizes.
Lanczos Ritz residuals and convergence histories are recorded.
The global gap is not inferred from only the L=0 sector.

disorder_protocol.profile_bound: Use analytic, interval-certified or explicitly numerical-only sup-norm status; a sampled maximum is not a proof of ||phi||_infinity <= 1.
disorder_protocol.claim_boundary: Finite-N sweeps are stress tests and cannot prove an N-independent disorder threshold or the full perturbative theorem.

stages: Symmetry reduction and exact block data
Lean proof of exact finite and limiting claims
proof_producing_pipeline.trust_model: Optimizer and floating-point solver are untrusted candidate generators. Only exact independent checkers and the Lean kernel may qualify proof-level claims.

open_research_frontiers.question: Can a symmetry-complete, adaptive multi-body operator family improve the exact lower bound beyond 0.2190037845?
open_research_frontiers.near_term_target: First produce a complete exact certificate above the current coefficient; do not promise to reach the finite-size gap.

open_research_frontiers.question: Can the improved unperturbed gamma bound strengthen the October bounded-disorder perturbation theorem, and which constants in the energy-descent/coercivity/bootstrap proof actually depend on it?
open_research_frontiers.caution: No perturbation threshold or gap improvement follows automatically from replacing gamma.

open_research_frontiers.question: Can derivative/coherent-state orbital operators replace the sphere's south-pole map under magnetic translations or nonuniform Chern-band geometry?
open_research_frontiers.caution: The current sphere SU(2) proof does not directly transfer; nonorthogonal Gram matrices and symmetry loss require new exact rank and positivity arguments.

open_research_frontiers.question: Can exact parametric SDP and rank-stability methods be adapted to higher-body clustering pseudopotentials?
Can symmetry-breaking scalar disorder response be benchmarked against the perturbative theorem with certified profile bounds and posterior uncertainty?
